clone.ref_text: Once upon a time, in a kingdom with far too many aeroplanes, there lived a family who had never once waited their turn. This is their story, more or less.

i01.text: Once upon a time, last Tuesday or thereabouts, there was a kingdom called Krayzee.
i01.asr: Once upon a time, last Tuesday or thereabouts, there was a kingdom called Krazy.

i02.text: Its royal family did not hunt, or fish, or open hospitals. They flew.
i02.asr: Its royal family did not hunt, or fish, or open hospitals, they flew.

i03.text: In nineteen oh seven, the Royal Chemist, attempting a self-buttering crumpet, invented impossi-rubber instead.
i03.asr: In 1907, the royal chemist, attempting a self-buttering crumpet, invented impossi rubber instead.

i04.text: The King had a biplane made of it that afternoon, flew it into the cathedral, bounced off, and declared aviation perfectly safe.
i04.asr: The king had a biplane made of it that afternoon, flew it into the cathedral, bounced off and declared aviation perfectly safe.

i05.text: Every royal aircraft since has been made of the stuff. And every rule of the air was written for other people.
i05.asr: Every Royal aircraft since has been made of the stuff, and every rule of the air was written for other people.

i06.text: Somebody still has to read those rules out. That is the control tower.
i06.asr: Somebody still has to read those rules out. That is the control tower.

i07.text: The tower remains calm. Mostly. It has a therapist, and a great deal of tea.
i07.asr: The tower remains calm, mostly. It has a therapist and a great deal of tea.

i08.text: The House of Pomfrey Smythe has won the Royal Hangar for two hundred years. They fly in mauve. They are insufferable.
i08.asr: The House of Pomfrey Smythe has won the royal hangar for two hundred years. They fly in mauve. They are insufferable.

i09.text: Which brings us... to you. This morning, the Queen ennobled you, for reasons nobody can quite remember.
i09.asr: Which brings us... to you. This morning the Queen ennobled you for reasons nobody can quite remember.

i10.text: You have a title, an aeroplane, and absolutely no intention of waiting your turn.
i10.asr: You have a title, an aeroplane, and absolutely no intention of waiting your turn.

n21.text: Lord Rupert Pomfrey-Smythe cut in front of you on your first day. He has not apologised. He never will.
n21.asr: Lord Rupert Pomfrey Smythe cut in front of you on your first day. He has not apologized. He never will.

n22.text: He is on final approach now. Return the favour.
n22.asr: He is on final approach now. Return the favor.

n31.text: The Bishop is waiting for his blessing flypast. There is a queue for the runway, and nobody has filled up your tank.
n31.asr: The bishop is waiting for his blessing fly past. There is a queue for the runway and nobody has filled up your tank.

n32.text: Commoners queue. You have a button.
n32.asr: Commoner's Q, you have a button.

n41.text: Lord Rupert has bought a biplane. It is mauve. He has challenged you to a race: the church, the castle, and home.
n41.asr: Lord Rupert has bought a biplane. It is mauve. He has challenged you to a race. The church, the castle, and home.

g_cut.text: that was a cut-in. On my final. It has been noted. In ink.
g_cut.asr: That was a cut-in on my final. It has been noted in ink.

g_land.text: you are number one. Apparently. Cleared to land, I suppose.
g_land.asr: You are number one, apparently. Cleared to land, I suppose.

r_cut.text: I say! That was my approach, you jumped-up little baronet!
r_cut.asr: I say that was my approach. You jumped up little baronet.

i_jump.text: you were number five for departure. You are now, it seems, airborne.
i_jump.asr: You were number five for departure. You are now, it seems, airborne.

i_fuel.text: refuelled, on the Crown's account. The Crown has been informed.
i_fuel.asr: Refueled on the crown's account, the crown has been informed.

i_bowser.text: a fuel bowser is being driven up the runway after you. Please do not ask how.
i_bowser.asr: A fuel bowser is being driven up the runway after you. Please do not ask how.

t_race.text: um, there are two of you on the runway. Is this a race? Are we allowed races?
t_race.asr: Um, there are two of you on the runway. Is this a race? Are we allowed races?

t_win.text: And the winner is... sorry. Sorry! I'm not supposed to say that on frequency.
t_win.asr: And the winner is... sorry, sorry, I'm not supposed to say that on frequency.

r_race.text: Do keep up, new money. The church, the castle, and home!
r_race.asr: Do keep up, new money, the church, the castle and home.

r_lose.text: Mother will hear about this. Mother hears about everything.
r_lose.asr: Mother will hear about this. Mother hears about everything.

r_win.text: Ha! Two hundred years of breeding, darling. Better luck next season.
r_win.asr: Ha! Two hundred years of breeding, darling. Better luck next season.

n51.text: The Queen has announced a coronation. Somebody will be crowned Sovereign of the Skies, and the tea must be perfect.
n51.asr: The Queen has announced a coronation. Somebody will be crowned sovereign of the skies, and the tea must be perfect.

n52.text: The cream comes from Muckle Bottom. Through the magic clouds, in Grandfather's Moth.
n52.asr: The cream comes from muckle bottom through the magic clouds in grandfather's moth.

n61.text: The coronation robes weigh four hundred pounds, and need pressing by the Royal Air Force.
n61.asr: The coronation robes weigh 400 pounds and need pressing by the Royal Air Force.

n62.text: Only the Wardrobe can carry them. The runway at Much Snoring points one way. You prefer the other.
n62.asr: Only the wardrobe can carry them. The runway at much snoring points one way. You prefer the other.

n71.text: Lord Rupert has told Farmer Mudge that jets cannot hover. Mudge has stopped the cream.
n71.asr: Lord Rupert has told Farmer Mudge that jets cannot hover. Mudge has stopped the cream.

n72.text: Take the Tantrum to Muckle Bottom and land it straight down. Somewhere he will notice.
n72.asr: Take the tantrum to Muckle Bottom and land it straight down, somewhere he will notice.

n81.text: Four hundred foreign royals are waiting at Much Snoring, with luggage. Only the Jumbo will do.
n81.asr: Four hundred foreign royals are waiting at much snoring, with luggage only the jumbo will do.

n82.text: Fly them home, and give the tower a proper view of the wings.
n82.asr: fly them home and give the tower a proper view of the wings.

n91.text: Lord Rupert is un-inviting people from the coronation. Personally. In mauve.
n91.asr: Lord Rupert is uninviting people from the coronation, personally, in mauve.

n92.text: Re-invite them. Low over every tower in the kingdom, in one flight.
n92.asr: Re-invite them, low over every tower in the kingdom in one flight.

n101.text: Coronation Day. By the statute of 1907, the crown goes to the winner of the Royal Bathtub Derby.
n101.asr: Coronation Day. By the statute of 1907, the crown goes to the winner of the Royal Bathtub Derby.

n102.text: Lord Rupert has been practising in the bath since he was four. The Queen is watching.
n102.asr: Lord Rupert has been practicing in the bath since he was four, the Queen is watching.

t_leave.text: you are leaving the circuit? Nobody leaves the circuit. Is that allowed? Have a lovely time!
t_leave.asr: You're leaving the circuit? Nobody leaves the circuit! Is that allowed? Have a lovely time!

m_hello.text: Muckle Bottom. You're after the cream, are you. Land on the grass and wipe your wheels.
m_hello.asr: Muckle Bottom, you're after the cream, are you? Land on the grass and wipe your wheels.

m_buzz.text: that was my water tank. My hat's in the pond. The cream's gone and turned to butter.
m_buzz.asr: That was my water tank, my hats in the pond, the creams gone and turned to butter.

m_cream.text: two pots of clotted cream, on the Crown's account. The Crown owes me for a hat.
m_cream.asr: Two pots of clotted cream on the crown's account. The crown owes me for a hat.

g_robes.text: the Royal Wardrobe is airborne. With the robes. Please do not open the back in flight.
g_robes.asr: The Royal Wardrobe is airborne with the robes, please do not open the back in flight.

i_wrong.text: Much Snoring. You are landing on runway zero-nine. Everyone else is landing on two-seven. Towards you.
i_wrong.asr: Much snoring. You are landing on runway 09. Everyone else is landing on 27 towards you.

i_wrong2.text: wrong way, at seventy tonnes. It has been filed. In triplicate. With a diagram.
i_wrong2.asr: Wrong way at seventy tons it has been filed, in triplicate, with a diagram.

i_robes.text: the robes are delivered. The pressing squadron has fainted. Standard procedure.
i_robes.asr: The robes are delivered. The pressing squadron has fainted. Standard procedure.

m_nojets.text: a jet? On my grass? Not till that thing learns to hover, Your Highness.
m_nojets.asr: A jet on my grass, not till that thing learns to hover your highness.

m_hover.text: it's... stopped. In the air. Doreen, come and look at this. Bring the bucket.
m_hover.asr: It's stopped, in the air. Doreen, come and look at this. Bring the bucket.

m_landed.text: right on the turnips. Straight down, like a tractor from heaven. The cream's back on.
m_landed.asr: right on the turnips, straight down like a tractor from heaven, the creams back on.

r_jets.text: Hover? Nonsense. Jets cannot hover. I read it in a book. Mother wrote the book.
r_jets.asr: Hover? Nonsense. Jets cannot hover. I read it in a book. Mother wrote the book.

i_jumbo.text: four hundred royal guests, cleared to depart. Eventually. Do not wait for it.
i_jumbo.asr: 400 royal guests cleared to depart. Eventually, do not wait for it.

t_jumbo.text: that is a very big aeroplane and it is very close to my window. Is it supposed to be this close?
t_jumbo.asr: That is a very big aeroplane, and it is very close to my window. Is it supposed to be this close?

g_owls.text: the owls have evacuated. All forty. In an orderly line. I am going with them.
g_owls.asr: The Owls have evacuated, all forty, in an orderly line. I'm going with them.

r_uninvite.text: Frightfully sorry, the coronation is cancelled. Moths. Do pass it on.
r_uninvite.asr: Frightfully sorry the coronation is cancelled. Moths, do pass it on.

m_invite.text: an invitation, dropped through the tank. The purple one said it was off. I'll bring the cream.
m_invite.asr: An invitation dropped through the tank. The purple one said it was off. I'll bring the cream.

i_invite.text: invitation received, at forty feet. RAF Much Snoring will attend. In uniform. Pressed.
i_invite.asr: Invitation received at 40 feet, RAF, much snoring will attend, in uniform pressed.

h_derby.text: Rupert, darling, do win. It is terribly common to lose at one's own coronation.
h_derby.asr: Rupert Darling do win, it is terribly common to lose at one's own coronation.

r_derby.text: Two hundred years of bath-time, darling. The crown is as good as on my head.
r_derby.asr: Two hundred years of bath time, darling. The crown is as good as on my head.

t_derby.text: two bathtubs on my runway. I have a laminated card for this. It just says "why".
t_derby.asr: Two bathtubs on my runway. I have a laminated card for this. It just says why.

t_crown.text: And the new Sovereign of the Skies is... sorry! Sorry. I'm allowed to say it this time!
t_crown.asr: And the new sovereign of the skies is... Sorry, sorry. I'm allowed to say it this time.

h_crown.text: I heard, darling. I thought it was marvellous.
h_crown.asr: I heard darling, I thought it was marvelous.

r_crownwin.text: And the crown goes to the bath of Pomfrey-Smythe! As was always intended.
r_crownwin.asr: And the crown goes to the bath of Pomfrey Smythe, as was always intended.
